senses.definition: A diurnal predatory bird of the family Accipitridae, smaller than an eagle.
examples: It is illegal to hunt hawks or other raptors in many parts of the world.

quotes.text:
He made his hawke to fly,
With hogeous showte and cry.

senses.definition: Any diurnal predatory terrestrial bird of similar size and appearance to the accipitrid hawks, such as a falcon.
(entomology) Any of various species of dragonfly of the genera Apocordulia and Austrocordulia, endemic to Australia.
(politics) An advocate of aggressive political positions and actions.
